Fix homepage layout on phone and tablet


## What changed

Updated the homepage navigation to prevent links from overlapping on tablet screens.

Adjusted the hero layout for smaller screens so the image appears above the heading and text.

Updated the playbook cards to stack vertically on smaller screens.

Fixed horizontal overflow on mobile devices.

Kept the desktop layout unchanged.

## How I tested it

Tested in Google Chrome using DevTools responsive mode.

Checked layouts at 480px, 768px, 900px, 1024px, 1200px, and 1440px.

Verified that the homepage does not scroll horizontally.

Verified that navigation links remain visible and do not overlap.

Verified that the playbook cards stack appropriately on smaller screens.

Checked that the desktop layout remains unchanged at 1440px.
